record.title: National-bank fiduciary/trustee route
kv: 12 USC 92a and implementing 12 CFR Part 9 distinguish fiduciary powers from the governing instrument and account duties.
A national bank seeks to act as trustee or other fiduciary for a particular instrument or estate.
National banks with applicable OCC fiduciary authority, validly appointed to the particular fiduciary account

Establish applicable fiduciary permission and any exceptions under Part 9. Recover the instrument or court order appointing the bank and defining duties. Apply fiduciary asset, recordkeeping and administration controls.
Charter, custody service, or listing does not establish trustee appointment. This does not determine state-chartered trust company or Delaware-law mechanics.

sources.label: 12 CFR Part 9 — Fiduciary activities of national banks
